messages.subject: Time recording — March narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Our records show unposted time for March on several matters. Please ensure all narratives are submitted by close of business Thursday so we can run the month-end billing cycle. Contact Accounts if you need a matter reopened for posting.

Accounts, Whitfield Carter LLP
